Name: Heber, the Kenite
Summary: Heber the Kenite had separated from the Kenites and pitched his tent near Kedesh; his wife Jael killed the fleeing Sisera in their tent. He is distinct from Heber, son of Beriah, in Genesis.
KeyStory: Heber, at peace with Jabin, had pitched his tent in the plain of Zaanaim; Sisera fled there trusting that peace, and Jael killed him.
LifeLesson: A household's peace treaty could not protect a tyrant from justice.
